title: 'We are in position of power': Iran's Pezeshkian seeks end to US war, claims victory
summary_full: Iranian President Pezeshkian seeks an end to the ongoing conflict, citing national strength and dignity.  He defended a past agreement against domestic criticism while military leaders warned of retaliation.  Oman and Iran discussed resuming dialogue as the Strait of Hormuz remains a critical flashpoint.  US President Trump indicated Iran was not ready for a suitable agreement.  Washington plans new sanctions, which Iran and China have criticized as ineffective.
